decisions.statement: A widget's taps are read and written through the page store.
A caller with a clone of the tree has no index to find a widget's file by.
A tap never reaches the commit.
Two taps arriving together cost one tap.
The moment of the last tap is written beside the count.
A widget with no count has taken no tap.
The two keys a tap is counted under are named here alone.
A count that is no number is refused rather than read as no tap.
A slug no widget page has answers with nothing.
Nothing here decides a tap happened.
The round trip to the store is proved by a test.

definition: the taps a widget has taken, counted through the page store
